north_star: Genuine out-of-family learned generalization with equal or lower full compute and memory, no increase in errors or hard false positives
task: Train and compare compact relational memory with learned state formation, query-blind memory retention, interventional action value, and counterfactual relational composition across unheard-of entity-role and causal-operator structures.

mechanism_hypotheses.novelty: learns reusable entity-slot and relation predicates from training; same capacity with symbolic typed embedding and GRU-style fully trained comparator
mechanism_hypotheses.ablate: freeze/randomize encoder and preserve all other components

mechanism_hypotheses.novelty: learns the forward utility of an episode-bound relation without seeing eventual test query; preserves relevant older causal bonds at equal slot capacity
mechanism_hypotheses.ablate: replace with recency and equally trained attention retention

mechanism_hypotheses.novelty: learn do(action) reward value conditioned on relational state from balanced intervention assignment; no confounded observational-as-causal leakage
mechanism_hypotheses.ablate: remove action updates and compare balanced supervised value baselines

mechanism_hypotheses.novelty: learn to compose intervention effects over multi-hop unfamiliar relational paths, not a handcrafted S3-affine operator lookup
mechanism_hypotheses.ablate: replace operator with same-budget memorized one-step and strongest symbolic composition

mechanism_hypotheses.novelty: combine E+R+A+C at equal physical slots, parameter and resource cap
mechanism_hypotheses.ablate: each component removed separately and all corresponding matched controls

source_policy.training: nonfirstuse TRAIN only after prereg; no previous T16-T21 DEV reuse
source_policy.validation: disjoint development validation; never claim independent science
source_policy.sealed_science: Requires independently authenticated source birth, signed witnessed first-use, identity freezing and preserved negative trials
source_policy.control_information: all arm TRAIN procedures receive identical intervention/observation evidence, no extra labels or hidden operator supplied to candidate

resources.full_process_measurements: startup, training, state encoding, memory writes/evictions, action learning, counterfactual composition, verification, matching baseline processing
resources.query_service_cost: must be measured before science; otherwise NOT_ACCEPTED
resources.accuracy_threshold: predeclared strict generalization improvement ≥5 percentage points over strongest eligible fully TRAIN-informed competitor, no per-family baseline regressions

Dream_RSI.use: reuse exact historical signed/propensity method only if qualified randomized TRAIN decision records actually exist; otherwise READ_ONLY_NODISPATCH

ThetaEvolve.use: training-only bounded advisory proposals; no direct code mutation or authority

Shinka_Pareto.use: use exact historical Pareto logic for sealed TRAIN candidate score/cost and family diversity; no sealed or first-use access

optimization_method.others: source-free/focused tests and deterministic capacity screens, no repeated scalar tuning of T19/T21B failures

eligibility_order: commit frozen hypothesis before implementation or new source
source-free family and causal leakage tests
bounded separate TRAIN development and equally informed controls, fully account resource metrics
freeze exact candidates and controls before independent first-use
one independently reproduced source-born transfer result with causal ablation and zero errors
one final full regression on exact accepted tree before any conditional promotion

coordination.Mass_Research: Share this design, negative aggregate T16-T21B receipts and admitted public abstraction only; NEVER send experimental source code generating unseen tasks, seed, first-use IDs, hidden labels, holdout contents or pre-dispatch model feedback
coordination.reproduction: independent source family and source handler must not train on optimizer-generated prospective cases
coordination.FORGE: only existing controller and qualification runners; no additional scheduler, no automatic FSA admission
